title: TierSlot
description: TIER-SPEC-01 (Home docs/design/tier-families-and-options-2026-10-30.md section 2). The value of one `engines.<role>.tier.<reduced|standard|boost|max>` setting: which model fills the slot and the options it runs with. `model` is a catalog candidate id, `recommended` (follows catalog updates) or `off` (the slot is switched off; the model stays installed). `options` is typed per category by vocab/resource-tiers.json; a name that category does not declare is invalid. The slot never holds a draft model (a launch setting, not an option). `who` is the optional Who can use it choice, defaulting by tier from the same vocab.

options.description: Option values by name. Names, types and ranges come from vocab/resource-tiers.json for the slot's category; the Stack and Home validate against it.

who.description: Who can use the slot. Absent means the tier's default in vocab/resource-tiers.json. Nobody may widen Max past the `tier.max` grant.

SwitchCost.description: How a tier is reached from another: an option switch, a same-family swap, or a cross-family load (vocab/resource-tiers.json).
